left join ptl_portfolio t6 on t1.portfolio_id = t6.parent_portfolio_id and (t6.portfolio_id in

null) OR T1.PORTFOLIO_ID IN (
#{prot,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

null) OR T1.PORTFOLIO_NAME in (
#{prot,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
or t6.parent_portfolio_id is not null
OR T1.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID in
null) OR T1.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID IN (
